title: Account on a laptop / lifestyle photograph
slide_intent: Show the product amid a person’s own objects because a financial service should feel embedded in life.
strategic_value: The card, laptop and personal desk can make Wise’s account offer tangible without relying on an isolated interface.
demonstration: An overhead view shows a person holding a green card in front of an open laptop on a desk with plants, papers and small objects.
practical_value: Decide which recognizable product cues need to remain visible in a wide lifestyle crop.
